package httpapi

import "net/http"

func (rt *Router) routes(mux *http.ServeMux) {
	rt.side.HandleFunc("GET /field", rt.handler)
	built := buildMux()
	built.HandleFunc("GET /built", rt.handler)
	undeclared.HandleFunc("GET /undeclared", rt.handler)
	register := mux.HandleFunc
	register("GET /method-value", rt.handler)
}
